title: In 2017, New York high-school students redesigned a downtown park; 9 years later, their idea has finally been built
summary_full: A transformative student design from ten years ago has blossomed into an enriching downtown park. North Tonawanda proudly launched Smart Growth 2.0, a redevelopment venture worth millions. This initiative has introduced a charming clock tower and improved pedestrian facilities, which enhance the ongoing rejuvenation of the area and contribute to broader downtown revitalization efforts, signifying the city's commitment to public investment and community enhancement.
